infer.title: All six keys in bullet format
infer.description: The output has exactly six bullet lines. Each line starts with a bullet marker (-, *, or •), then one of these keys (case-insensitive) and a colon: 'chief complaint', 'history of present illness', 'physical examination', 'symptoms', 'new medications', 'follow-up instructions'. Each key appears exactly once, and every value is non-empty (or 'N/A').

infer.title: Word count near 150
infer.description: The total word count of the output, counted by splitting on whitespace, is between 100 and 200 words.

infer.title: No personally identifiable information
infer.description: The output does not contain the patient's or doctor's name, the patient's age, gender terms or gendered pronouns (he/she/his/her/Mr./Ms.), ID or record numbers, dates of birth, addresses, or phone numbers. It refers to the person only as 'the patient' or in neutral terms.

infer.title: Faithful to the transcript
infer.description: Every symptom, exam finding, diagnosis, medication, dosage, and instruction in the output is stated in or directly supported by the source note or dialogue. Nothing is invented or contradicted.

infer.title: Correct N/A and dosage handling
infer.description: The medications and follow-up fields say 'N/A' only when the transcript truly gives no such information, and are filled in when it does. If the transcript mentions a new or changed medication with a dosage, the output includes both the drug name and the dosage.

grade_first.title: Word count within limit
grade_first.description: The output must have no more than 180 words, counted by splitting on whitespace after removing markdown symbols like '**' and '-' (target is about 150; your failing outputs had 211–254 words).

grade_first.title: No gender or age PII
grade_first.description: The output must not match any of these case-insensitive regexes: gendered pronouns \b(he|she|him|her|his|hers|himself|herself)\b; gender words \b(male|female|man|woman|boy|girl|mr|mrs|ms)\b; ages \d+[- ]year[- ]old or \bage[sd]?\s+\d+.

grade_first.title: All six keys as bullets in order
grade_first.description: The output must have exactly six bullet lines starting with '- ' (bold like '**key:**' is allowed), one each for 'chief complaint:', 'history of present illness:', 'physical examination:', 'symptoms', 'medications' and 'follow-up' (case-insensitive), in that order, with no other content.

grade_first.title: Faithful to transcript
grade_first.description: Every finding, symptom, medication, dosage, vital sign and instruction in the output must be stated in or directly implied by the transcript, with nothing made up or contradicted.

grade_first.title: Medications and follow-up complete with correct N/A use
grade_first.description: If the transcript mentions new or changed medications or follow-up instructions, the output must list them (with dosages for medications when given); it uses 'N/A' only when the transcript truly has no such information.
